manifest.name: dsh-work-done-bell
manifest.description: Rings a Windows system sound (and shows a bottom-right toast) when a DeepSeek Harness session has actually finished all of its work — idle plus no live background job and no running subagent.

scripts.test: node test/state-machine.test.mjs && node test/integration.test.mjs && node test/client-bundle.test.mjs && node test/docs-parity.test.mjs

manifest.author: FunctionHookTJU

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: inserts this plugin into a profile's layer stack.
#
# A bundle patch is the composition layer a plugin owns, so installing this
# package into a profile is enough — the row below is applied after the
# profile's bundles and before the profile's own cordis.patch.yml.
#
# The row publishes no service, so it needs no `isolate` realm; it consumes the
# host registries (`agents`, `jobs`, `shell`, `webServer`, `settings`, `timer`)
# and registers into `tools` plus the client slot tree. It is deliberately a
# HOST-plane row: it must see every session, not just the ones using one
# preset.
- insert:
    - id: work-done-bell
      name: 'dsh-work-done-bell'

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
rings a **Windows system sound** when a session has *actually finished*, and
shows a **bottom-right toast** naming the session that finished. A persistent
bottom-right switch turns both off, and that preference is stored in a real
settings namespace, so it survives a restart.

`agent/status -> idle` means only that the agent's driver has nothing scheduled.
Work routinely outlives it:

- a `run_in_background` job keeps running and its settlement opens **another**
  turn, and
- a delegated subagent keeps running while its parent sits idle.

Chiming on raw `idle` therefore rings two or three times per task. This plugin
waits for **quiescence**: `idle` *and* no `running`/`stopping` job owned by the
session *and* no running agent owned by it. A 90-second deadline bounds that
wait, so a long build cannot swallow the notification; once the deadline has
rung, the later true quiescence stays silent for the same episode.

The reason comes from the durable session log (`turn/end`), not from a guess:

| `turn/end` reason | Sound | Toast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | `Asterisk` (default notification) | yes |
| `blocked` (a plugin rejected the step) | `Asterisk` | yes |
| `max-tokens` (output ceiling hit) | `Asterisk` | yes |
| `error` | `Hand` (critical stop) | yes |
| `aborted` — including your own Esc/Stop | silent | no |
| `interrupted` (crash-orphaned turn) | silent | no |

Simultaneous completions within 2.5 s collapse into one sound, so five sessions
finishing together do not stack five players.

Clone the repository, then install it from the directory you cloned into:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/FunctionHookTJU/dsh-work-done-bell
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-work-done-bell
```

then add the package name to the profile's bundle list, in
`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "...", "dsh-work-done-bell"]

(`dsh plugin add` reconciles that list itself when the installed package
declares `dsh.bundle`. Restart DSH afterwards; nothing else in the composition
needs editing.)

> **Use `file:`, not `link:`.** The plugin resolves
> `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` by walking up from its own directory into the
> profile's `node_modules`. A `link:` install keeps the real path outside the
> profile and the import fails at load.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-work-done-bell
```

Remove it from `dsh.profile.bundles` (which `dsh plugin remove` also reconciles),
then restart. The `work-done-bell` namespace in `settings.yaml` is inert once
the plugin is gone and can be deleted by hand.

Bottom-right, always visible: *完成提示已开 / 完成提示已关*. It writes
`work-done-bell.enabled` through the settings service, and both halves read it —
the host half stops the sound, the browser half stops the toast. The state lives
in `<DSH_HOME>/settings.yaml`, so it survives a restart.

There is no model-facing tool, on purpose: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is not
present in the profile, and a plugin may only import what the profile already
carries (ESM resolution ignores `NODE_PATH`). The state route carries the same
information instead:

```sh
curl "http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-work-done-bell/state?verbose=1"
```

That returns tracked statuses, the last `turn/end` reason per session, open
quiescence episodes with their deadlines, the last sound exit code, and any
error the plugin swallowed. Without `?verbose=1` it returns only what the
browser half needs.

- **Windows only** for the sound: it plays through
  `[System.Media.SystemSounds]`, executed via the composed `shell` service. On
  other platforms the plugin loads and toasts, but stays silent. Porting it
  means changing the command in `play()` to `afplay` / `paplay`.
- **The sound command carries a resolved sandbox policy.** A confining shell
  service refuses a command that arrives without one, and the deployment
  default may be a mode the host cannot enforce at all — on the machine this
  was built on, `workspace-write` fails because the Windows ACL runner wants a
  temp root outside the workspace while the workspace is the user profile, so
  *nothing* runs confined and an unpolicied command is simply refused. The
  policy is therefore resolved per chime for the session being announced
  (`sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session })`), which is that session's own
  authority, never a widening of it. On such a host a session confined to
  `workspace-write` stays silent; `?verbose=1` reports the reason in
  `lastError` and the resolved mode in `lastPolicy`.
- The toast requires an open page; the sound does not.
- The browser half polls the host every second over
  `/dsh-work-done-bell/s

Four suites, all runnable with no harness running:

```sh
npm test                           # all four
node test/state-machine.test.mjs   # the decision table, on a manual clock
node test/integration.test.mjs     # the plugin inside a REAL cordis app
node test/client-bundle.test.mjs   # the browser bundle's contract

`integration.test.mjs` is the one that matters most: it boots a real
`@deepseek-ai/cordis` application with stub services and asserts that `apply`
runs, that `ctx.inject` fires, and that both HTTP routes register. An earlier
version of this plugin read `ctx.get('webServer')` once at apply time and
called `jobs.onJobsChanged` unguarded; it looked healthy while registering
nothing in production, because a host-composition row mounts *during boot*,
before its services exist.

The suites need `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer`,
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` and `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` resolvable from the
repository. A checkout links them from the harness installation; `node_modules`
is gitignored, so these links stay local:

```powershell
$repo  = (Get-Location).Path   # this checkout
$dsh   = "$env:APPDATA
pm
ode_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh
ode_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$web   = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web
ode_modules\@deepseek-ai"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$repo
ode_modules\@deepseek-ai" | Out-Null

`docs-parity.test.mjs` guards the two readmes against drift: the same heading
skeleton, the same code blocks, the same tables, the same inline technical
terms. It cannot judge the prose, but it fails the moment one language grows a
section the other lacks.

```
lib/index.js      host half  — quiescence state machine, sound, HTTP route
client/client.js  client half — shell.overlay toast stack and switch
cordis.patch.yml  the composition row this package contributes
test/             decision table, real-cordis integration, client + readme contracts
MIT

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：
当一次会话**真正把所有活干完**时，响一声 **Windows 系统提示音**，并在**右下角
弹出 toast** 写明是哪次会话完成了。右下角还有一个常驻开关可以同时关掉两者，这个
偏好写进真实的 settings 命名空间，所以重启后依然有效。

readme.section: 为什么 "idle" 不等于 "干完了"
readme.text:
`agent/status -> idle` 只说明 agent 的驱动手上没有排到事情。活经常比它活得久：

- `run_in_background` 启动的后台作业还在跑，等它落地会**再开一轮**；
- 被委派出去的子代理还在跑，而它的父代理已经 idle 了。

所以对着裸的 `idle` 直接响铃，一个任务会响两三次。本插件等的是**彻底静默**：
`idle` *且* 该会话名下没有处于 `running`/`stopping` 的作业 *且* 名下没有在跑的
agent。这个等待有 90 秒的截止时间兜底，长构建吞不掉这声提示；一旦在截止时间响过，
同一轮里随后那次真正的静默就不再出声。

readme.section: 各种结束原因对应什么声音
readme.text:
原因取自持久化的会话日志（`turn/end`），不是猜出来的：

| `turn/end` 原因 | 声音 | Toast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | `Asterisk`（默认通知音） | 有 |
| `blocked`（某个插件驳回了这一步） | `Asterisk` | 有 |
| `max-tokens`（撞到输出上限） | `Asterisk` | 有 |
| `error` | `Hand`（严重错误音） | 有 |
| `aborted` —— 包括你自己按的 Esc/停止 | 静音 | 无 |
| `interrupted`（崩溃后遗留的孤儿轮次） | 静音 | 无 |

2.5 秒内同时完成的会话会合并成一声，所以五个会话一起结束不会叠出五个播放器。

先克隆仓库，再从克隆下来的目录安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/FunctionHookTJU/dsh-work-done-bell
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-work-done-bell
```

然后把包名加进 profile 的 bundle 列表，也就是
`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/package.json`：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "...", "dsh-work-done-bell"]

（安装的包只要声明了 `dsh.bundle`，`dsh plugin add` 就会自己把这份列表对上。之后
重启 DSH，组合里其它地方都不用动。）

> **用 `file:`，别用 `link:`。** 插件是靠从自己所在目录向上走进 profile 的
> `node_modules` 才解析到 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 的。`link:` 安装会把真实
> 路径留在 profile 之外，于是 import 在加载时直接失败。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-work-done-bell
```

把它从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里去掉（`dsh plugin remove` 也会顺带对上这份列表），
然后重启。插件没了之后 `settings.yaml` 里的 `work-done-bell` 命名空间就只是躺着不
起作用，可以手动删掉。

右下角常驻可见：*完成提示已开 / 完成提示已关*。它通过 settings 服务写
`work-done-bell.enabled`，两半都读它 —— 宿主那一半停掉声音，浏览器那一半停掉
toast。状态存在 `<DSH_HOME>/settings.yaml`，所以重启后依然有效。

故意没有面向模型的工具：这个 profile 里没有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`，而插件只能
import profile 本身已经带的包（ESM 解析不看 `NODE_PATH`）。同样的信息改由 state
路由承载：

```sh
curl "http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-work-done-bell/state?verbose=1"
```

它返回被跟踪的状态、每个会话最后一次 `turn/end` 的原因、还开着的静默观察周期及其
截止时间、上一次响铃的退出码，以及插件吞掉的任何错误。不带 `?verbose=1` 时只返回
浏览器那一半需要的东西。

- **声音仅限 Windows**：它通过组合出来的 `shell` 服务执行
  `[System.Media.SystemSounds]` 来播放。在其他平台上插件能加载、能弹 toast，但不
  出声。移植的办法就是把 `play()` 里的命令换成 `afplay` / `paplay`。
- **响铃命令带着一份解析过的 sandbox policy。** 有约束的 shell 服务会拒绝一份没带
  policy 的命令，而部署默认的那个模式可能宿主根本执行不了 —— 在构建这个插件的机器
  上，`workspace-write` 就是跑不起来的：Windows ACL 运行器要求临时根目录位于工作区
  之外，而工作区是用户主目录，于是受约束的命令**一条都跑不了**，不带 policy 的命令
  则被直接拒绝。因此 policy 是每次响铃时针对被通报的那个会话解析的
  （`sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session })`），用的是那个会话自己的权限，绝不放大它。
  在这样的宿主上，被约束在 `workspace-write` 的会话会保持静音；`?verbose=1` 会在
  `lastError` 里给出原因，在 `lastPolicy` 里给出解析出的模式。
- Toast 需要页面开着；声音不需要。
- 浏览器那一半每秒通过 `/dsh-work-done-bell/state` 轮询宿主。没有推送通道：包之间
  被认可的方向是 浏览器 -> 宿主。
- Toast 用短 id 标注会话，不是标题。

四套测试，都不需要 DSH 在跑：

```sh
npm test                           # 四套全跑
node test/state-machine.test.mjs   # 决策表，跑在手动时钟上
node test/integration.test.mjs     # 插件装在一个真实的 cordis 应用里
node test/client-bundle.test.mjs   # 浏览器 bundle 的契约

`integration.test.mjs` 是最要紧的一套：它用一个真实的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 应用加桩
服务启动，断言 `apply` 跑起来了、`ctx.inject` 触发了、两个 HTTP 路由都注册了。这个
插件的早期版本在 apply 时读一次 `ctx.get('webServer')`，又不加保护地调用
`jobs.onJobsChanged`；它看起来一切正常，生产里却什么都没注册 —— 因为宿主组合的一行
是在*启动过程中*挂载的，那时候它的服务还不存在。

测试需要能从仓库解析到 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer`、
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 和 `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit`。检出的仓库把它们从 harness
安装里链接过来；`node_modules` 已 gitignore，所以这些链接只留在本地：

```powershell
$repo  = (Get-Location).Path   # 当前检出的仓库
$dsh   = "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$web   = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$repo\node_modules\@deepseek-ai" | Out-Null

`docs-parity.test.mjs` 守住两份 README 不漂移：标题骨架、代码块、表格、行内技术
名词都必须一致。它判断不了行文，但只要一种语言多出一节而另一种没有，它立刻失败。

```
lib/index.js      宿主一半 —— 静默状态机、声音、HTTP 路由
client/client.js  浏览器一半 —— shell.overlay 的 toast 栈与开关
cordis.patch.yml  这个包贡献的那一行组合
test/             决策表、真实 cordis 集成、客户端与 README 契约
MIT
